en.headline: Hang Seng Index rebounds over 1.8 percent by midday after seven-day slide
en.dek: The benchmark closed the morning session at 22,373 points, up 407 points, as tech shares led a recovery from recent losses.
body: Hong Kong stocks rebounded on Thursday after a seven-session losing streak, with the Hang Seng Index rising sharply in morning trade.

The index closed the morning session at 22,373.81 points, up 407.80 points or 1.86 percent from the previous close of 21,966.01. Gains continued into the afternoon, with the index trading above 22,400 points at times.
Technology shares led the advance, recovering from steep declines earlier in the week that had been driven by concerns over potential US tariffs and AI valuations.

zh.headline: 恒指連跌七日後反彈 半日升逾1.8%報22373點
zh.dek: 恒生指數早市收報22373點，升407點，科技股帶動下從近日跌勢回升。
body: 港股周四在連跌七個交易日後反彈，恒生指數早市顯著上升。
指數早市收報22373.81點，較前收21966.01點升407.80點，升幅1.86%。午後升勢持續，指數一度高於22400點。
科技股領漲，從本周較早因美國關稅憂慮及人工智能估值問題而出現的大幅下跌中回升。
